collection.label: Rigveda
collection.edition_label: Padapāṭha (word-by-word text written in the manuscript; Sansknet e-text via GRETIL)
collection.search_terms: rigveda rig veda rgveda vedic hymns sanskrit agni indra soma purusha nasadiya hiranyagarbha gayatri
collection.description: The complete Rigveda, the oldest collection of Sanskrit hymns, hymn by hymn (1,028 hymns): Aufrecht's accented text, Griffith's English, and the page of a Devanagari manuscript in the University of Pennsylvania collection that carries each verse: a padapāṭha copy of the whole Rigveda, a saṃhitā copy of 1711 for 10.46-10.191, and a copy of 1737 for the Gāyatrī hymn (3.62).
